classification.difficultyReason: Read quartile positions off a box plot and convert segments to 25%, 50% or 75% of 360. Part c combines two disjoint whiskers, and part b needs min to Q3 as three quartiles. Slightly more than single-section counts, less than the two-group multi-step counts of p17-q2.

content.prompt: The box plot shows the waiting times of 360 patients at a medical clinic. How many patients waited:

answer.worked:
From the lower quartile to the median is $25\%$ of the patients.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Number}&=360\times0.25\\&=90\end{align*}$$

From the minimum to the upper quartile is $75\%$ of the patients.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Number}&=360\times0.75\\&=270\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: between 5 and 15 minutes or between 35 and 50 minutes?

answer.worked:
Each of these regions is $25\%$ of the patients, so together they are $50\%$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Number}&=360\times0.5\\&=180\end{align*}$$
